S5 storage admission and durable execution rejects a superseded recovery generation at the PVC write fence before creating any claim (restoreLocked=true)

correctionsValidated: Service detach ignores another service only when verified Pod ancestry matches a live ManagedResource root UID/name/kind and the full stored platform target.
Unknown, spoofed, substituted, truncated or current-service mounts retain occupancy; independent volume maintenance and destruction still require all Pods to exit.
Read deadline publishes STORAGE_OBSERVATION_TIMEOUT immediately, preserving prior useful samples; shutdown cancellation does not fabricate an outage.
Generation replacement and restore-lock activation both stop before the PVC write fence with VOLUME_TASK_FENCE_LOST.
limits: This is not real K3s storage or database initialization acceptance.
No real backup, restore, data checksum transfer, node scheduling, capacity enforcement, or off-host durability is certified by this suite.
Manual records remain operator_reported and never imply platform verification.
Real A/B cluster acceptance and the main database migration are separate work owned by the parent agent.
